endpoints.summary: Score a binding pose via metadynamics. Returns a JobInfo; poll until done.
endpoints.description: Score a binding pose via metadynamics. Returns a JobInfo; poll until done.

request_fields.name: lig_resname
request_fields.description: Ligand residue name in the topology (upstream argparse default is 'MOL'; some systems use 'LIG'/'UNK' — match your file).

request_fields.name: nreps
request_fields.description: Number of independent metadynamics repeats (run in series). 10 is the standard BPMD protocol.

request_fields.name: hill_height
request_fields.description: Metadynamical hill height in kcal/mol. 0.3 is standard.

request_fields.name: system_format
request_fields.description: Force input format. None = auto-detect by extension (.gro -> gromacs, else amber).

request_fields.name: sim_ns
request_fields.description: ADVANCED/TESTING: production metadynamics length in ns. None -> upstream standard 10 ns. Non-standard values break score comparability.

request_fields.name: equil_steps
request_fields.description: ADVANCED/TESTING: NVT equilibration steps (2 fs each). None -> upstream standard 250000 (500 ps).

examples.title: score a docked pose (Amber system)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score -F structure=@solvated.rst7 -F parameters=@solvated.prm7 -F lig_resname=MOL -F nreps=10 -F hill_height=0.3
examples.notes: Long-running (hours on 1 GPU). Returns a JobInfo; poll /api/jobs/<id> until completed, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/files for results.csv.

examples.title: Gromacs system via OSS URIs
examples.notes: URI inputs avoid the 128 KiB multipart cap.

examples.title: FC async task mode (single 202 + blocking compute)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/tasks/score -H 'X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async' -H 'X-Bioagent-Job-Id: bpmd-001' -F structure_uri=oss://mybucket/solvated.rst7 -F parameters_uri=oss://mybucket/solvated.prm7 -F lig_resname=MOL -F nreps=10
examples.notes: Returns 202; FC keeps the instance alive until the metadynamics finishes. Duplicate submits with the same X-Bioagent-Job-Id are deduped. Prefer URI inputs (128 KiB async payload cap).

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: OpenBPMD
model.paper: Lukauskis et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2022, 62, 6209-6216 (DOI:10.1021/acs.jcim.2c01142)
model.method: Binding Pose Metadynamics (OpenMM), Clark et al. 2016 protocol
model.task: ligand binding-pose stability scoring / post-docking re-ranking (NOT a binding free-energy / affinity predictor)
model.typical_duration: hours (10 reps x 10 ns, serial, single GPU)
model.score_semantics: CompScore = PoseScore - 5*ContactScore; MORE NEGATIVE = more stable pose. PoseScore = ligand heavy-atom RMSD (lower better); ContactScore = fraction of native contacts retained (higher better).

tool_outputs.results.csv: final CompScore/PoseScore/ContactScore + SD, averaged over the last 2 ns of each rep (single row).
tool_outputs.scoring_stats.json: wrapper summary: nreps_done, comp/pose/contact score, wall_time_s, platform, sim_ns.

input_requirements.system: PRE-SOLVATED + PARAMETRISED complex (Amber .prm7/.rst7 OR Gromacs .top/.gro). OpenBPMD does NOT prepare systems — provide ligand FF params, water, and ions upstream.
input_requirements.lig_resname: must match the ligand residue name in the topology (default 'MOL').

config_tips.nreps: 10 is the standard BPMD protocol; reduce for a faster/cheaper triage at lower confidence.
config_tips.hill_height: 0.3 kcal/mol is standard; do not change unless replicating a specific study.
config_tips.sim_ns: ADVANCED/TESTING ONLY. Leave unset. Non-standard lengths break comparability with published BPMD scores.
config_tips.large_inputs: Use *_uri (oss:// / job:// / file://) — a typical .prm7 is ~8 MB and exceeds the FC async 128 KiB event-payload cap for multipart uploads.

input_uri_schemes.file:///<path>: absolute path on the FC NAS mount
